bladesinger.summary: A Wizard of an elven tradition that weaves swordplay and dance into spellcasting.

Bladesong.summary: Bonus Action, with no armor or Shield: for 1 minute add INT to AC (min +1), gain +10 ft Speed and Advantage on Acrobatics, attack with INT, and add INT to Concentration saves. Ends if you're Incapacitated, don armor or a Shield, or attack two-handed. INT modifier uses (min 1) per Long Rest; Arcane Recovery restores one.

options.name: Agility
options.summary: +INT to AC (min +1), +10 ft Speed and Advantage on DEX (Acrobatics) checks.

options.name: Bladework
options.summary: Use INT for attack and damage rolls with weapons you're proficient with.

options.name: Focus
options.summary: Add INT to CON saves to keep Concentration.

Training in War and Song.summary: Proficiency with Martial Melee weapons lacking Two-Handed and Heavy, which can serve as your spellcasting focus. Gain one of Acrobatics, Athletics, Performance or Persuasion.

grants.value: Martial Melee weapons without the Two-Handed or Heavy property

Extra Attack.summary: Attack twice with the Attack action, and one of those attacks can be swapped for a Wizard cantrip that takes an action.

Song of Defense.summary: Reaction when you take damage during Bladesong: spend a spell slot to cut the damage by five times its level.

Song of Victory.summary: After casting a spell with a casting time of an action, make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action.
